target_customer: Large enterprises that license restaurant and menu data
problem: Enterprises that sell to or analyze restaurants lack clean, structured restaurant data such as menus and locations.
business_model: B2B data licensing and data infrastructure (legal entity Pepper API, Inc.)

founders.name: Richard Kreger
founders.background_notes: Named on the YC page with no bio. A job board page (not a company source) says Cameron Cairns is CTO, so he is not listed as a founder here.

technical_complexity.rationale: Collecting and normalizing restaurant data is mostly scraping and data cleaning work.

defensibility.rationale: Data coverage can compound, but menu data is gatherable by others.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found; Datassential launched a menu pricing product in 2023 (later than the batch).

market_need_then: No sourced evidence of demand at founding beyond the YC batch listing.

branding.domain_note: spicedata.com; the footer names Pepper API, Inc. as the operating entity.

brand_strength.rationale: Minimal one page site, no press, and confusable with the unrelated Spice AI.

outcome_analysis: Spice Data is listed active with a one page site and a trademark owned by Pepper API, Inc. No funding, acquisition or press was found, so its trajectory is not public. A job board claims it raised only from YC and angels and is profitable, which is unverified.
notes: Searches returned mostly the unrelated Spice AI (a Web3 data company with a $13.5M seed); ignored. The claims about Cameron Cairns, YC and angel funding and profitability come from a job board snippet and are unverified. Competitor search found only 2023 and later Datassential pages, so the list is empty.
